svg.aria-label: HARPY. Catch the agent that started it. Budgeted oversight for multi-agent AI: a sentinel audits a sample of the mesh, flags a relay carrying a bad claim, and blame tracing walks the claim's lineage back to the agent that originated it, which is isolated.
